DCE Command Center V3 — optional server provider configuration

Realtime sync and stakeholder portal work with no paid provider credentials once the V3 server is running.

For in-app email (Resend):
DCE_RESEND_API_KEY=...
DCE_EMAIL_FROM=DCE Projects <demo@example.invalid>

For SMS + click-to-call (Twilio):
TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=...
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=...
TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER=+1...
DCE_CALLER_NUMBER=+1...   (the PM phone that should ring first for click-to-call)

Optional inbound communications webhook protection:
DCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=...

Optional server port:
DCE_PORT=8787

Do not put these secrets into DCE_Command_Center_V3.html.

SECURITY — RECOMMENDED FOR PHONE / OTHER-PC ACCESS
By default the server now binds only to 127.0.0.1.
For Tailscale/LAN access, set BOTH:
DCE_HOST=0.0.0.0
DCE_API_TOKEN=<long-random-secret>

The browser will ask for the token once per session and keeps it in sessionStorage only.
The server refuses a non-loopback bind without DCE_API_TOKEN unless you deliberately set:
DCE_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED=1
Do not use that override on an internet-reachable host.

Inbound communications are disabled unless this is set:
DCE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=<long-random-secret>
